newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ boy survives after tractor drives over his head.
newsitem.headline: NZ boy survives after tractor drives over his head.

text.p: A three-year-old New Zealand boy escaped death on Wednesday after a heavy farm tractor drove over his head.
The boy fell into the path of the tractor driven by a contractor working in scrub near Kaikoura, on the South Island, police said.
"How he survived I don't know, but he did. At one stage the tractor had stopped on the boy's head and had to be driven off," a police spokesman said.
"The sand may have assisted and he was talking quite happily when he left in the helicopter," he said.
The boy, whose father had been helping the contractor, was flown to a Christchurch hospital by helicopter with moderate head injuries.
A spokeswoman for the hospital later said the boy was in comfortable condition and was awake and chatting with his parents.
